pose: A highly detailed, macro shot of a paleontological preparation laboratory table, showcasing a delicate, fossilized pterosaur skeleton intersecting a continuous block made entirely of volcanic tuff, masterfully displaying how different geological formations color this specific rock matrix. The tuff matrix is divided into distinct, vibrant bands based on regional mineral chemistry and ash composition: on the far left, the light, chalky-white ash-tuff of the Solnhofen-adjacent regions shifts into a soft, pastel pink and lavender-tinted tuff variant. The center reveals a rich, iron-rich ochre yellow and deep terracotta-orange tuff. The right side transitions into a striking, mineral-veined celadon green and dark, smoky slate-grey volcanic tuff layer. A preparator's hand is visible using a fine camel-hair brush to sweep away loose ash particles, exposing the dark, amber-colored petrified bone. The scene is lit by crisp, clinical white task lights that make the rich spectrum of volcanic tuff colors pop vividly for clear gameplay matching.
